proposals.action_title: Launch and Monetize the First KDP Coloring Book
proposals.why_this_works_now: The coloring book pipeline is near completion. Launching the first high-quality book immediately targets high-margin organic search traffic on Amazon without ad spend, validating the generation engine.
proposals.first_action_today: Select the best 25 images generated via Together AI/FLUX-schnell, compile them into a print-ready PDF using a GitHub Actions workflow, and upload to KDP.

proposals.action_title: Bulk Upload 50 Scalable Vector Designs to Redbubble
proposals.why_this_works_now: Redbubble accounts require zero upfront listing fees. Leveraging the existing 'produce_merch_designs' pipeline with high-converting, text-based minimalist quotes bypasses complex image generation issues and matches current trends.
proposals.first_action_today: Run the 'produce_quotes_minimal' pipeline to generate 50 clean SVG/PNG text designs and upload them using a simple Python script or Termux browser.

proposals.action_title: Publish 3 Functional Parametric STL Models on Cults3D
proposals.why_this_works_now: Functional 3D prints (brackets, organizers, adapters) sell consistently because buyers own 3D printers and seek immediate utility. OpenSCAD code can be generated programmatically on Termux.
proposals.first_action_today: Execute the 'produce_stl_parametric' pipeline to generate 3 storage/utility models, render their previews, and list them on Cults3D at 1.99 EUR each.

proposals.action_title: Set Up an itch.io Storefront for Godot Assets
proposals.why_this_works_now: The Godot engine is exploding in popularity due to Unity's licensing shifts. Small game templates, UI kits, or script packages ('produce_godot_assets') have immediate demand among solo devs on itch.io.
proposals.first_action_today: Package a simple 2D game scaffold or UI template from your existing Godot pipelines, write a short markdown description, and publish it as 'Pay What You Want' with a suggested price of 3.99 EUR.

proposals.action_title: Implement High-Conversion KDP Backend Metadata Optimization
proposals.why_this_works_now: With zero budget for ads, search visibility is 100% dependent on the 7 backend keyword boxes and subtitle optimization. Maximizing long-tail niches ensures organic impressions.
proposals.first_action_today: Extract search terms using free Amazon autocomplete search via Termux curl commands, then structure the coloring book's subtitle and backend keywords around low-competition search phrases.
